observation_summary: The methods return negative values for inputs involving Integer.MIN_VALUE instead of throwing an ArithmeticException.
reasoning_summary: The MathUtils.gcd and MathUtils.lcm methods fail to handle edge cases involving Integer.MIN_VALUE correctly. Specifically, when the result of these operations would exceed the range of a positive 32-bit signed integer (i.e., greater than Integer.MAX_VALUE), the methods return an incorrect negative value instead of throwing an ArithmeticException as expected by the API contract and the test suite. The failing tests confirm that the code does not throw the required exception when encountering these overflow-prone inputs.
